Marsiva MR-UF3000 3000VA Smart Line-Interactive UPS

The Marsiva MR-UF3000 3000VA Smart Line-Interactive UPS offers superior power protection and reliability for your critical devices. With a powerful 3000VA / 1800W capacity, this UPS ensures that your computers, servers, networking equipment, and home appliances stay protected from power interruptions, voltage fluctuations, and surges.

Designed with Automatic Voltage Regulation (AVR), the MR-UF3000 stabilizes input voltage fluctuations, preventing unnecessary switching to battery mode. This enhances the longevity of the battery and provides stable power to your connected devices. The simulated sine wave output ensures compatibility with sensitive electronics, providing safe and efficient power for a wide range of applications.

Equipped with advanced features such as cold start function, off-mode charging, and silent mode operation, the MR-UF3000 is built for flexibility and performance. With an easy-to-read LED display, real-time audible alarms, and comprehensive protection against overload, short circuit, and overcharge, this UPS ensures your devices remain safe and powered up at all times.


Technical Specifications:

  • Model: Marsiva MR-UF3000
  • Type: Smart Line-Interactive UPS
  • Capacity: 3000VA / 1800W
  • Input Voltage: 220V – 240V AC
  • Output Voltage: 220V – 240V AC
  • Frequency: 50Hz / 60Hz (Auto-sensing)
  • Waveform: Simulated sine wave
  • Transfer Time: 2–6ms typical, max 10ms
  • Battery Type: 12V / 9Ah × 4
  • Recharge Time: 4 – 6 hours to 90% capacity
  • Dimensions: 398 × 145 × 215 mm
  • Weight: 20 kg
  • Noise Level: <40dB @ 1 meter
